result.title: ReLift: Dense 3D Tracking as Lifted Trajectory Repair
result.summary: Dense 3D tracking from monocular video requires establishing point correspondences over time, estimating their depth, and inferring their trajectories during occlusion. Existing methods typically learn these tasks jointly, a demanding objective given the scarcity of 4D supervision. We show that strong pretrained 2D trackers and 3D geometry models provide an effective foundation: lifted trajectories, with occluded segments simply interpolated, already rival dedicated 3D trackers using the same geometry. However, lifted trajectories inherit correspondence and depth errors, and under occlusion, their depth comes from the occluder rather than the tracked point. We introduce ReLift, an efficient feed-forward framework that recasts dense 3D tracking as geometric trajectory repair and completion. At its core, a trajectory corrector alternates attention along and across trajectories to preserve reliable observations, repair corrupted positions, and complete missing motion. Using only geometric inputs allows us to train directly on 3D trajectories with simulated lifting errors, decoupling training from images and from any specific tracker or geometry model. Concentrating 4D supervision on trajectory refinement yields a reusable model that consistently improves lifted trajectories across trackers and geometry providers without retraining, so it benefits directly from future advances in either component. On WorldTrack, ReLift achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy, improving on the strongest baselines by 2.1 APD on all points and 3.0 on dynamic points, with faster configurations remaining competitive with leading 3D trackers while running faster than 4RC. Visit our supplementry page for more examples and code.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把单目视频的密集3D跟踪重构为「提升轨迹修复」：先用预训练2D跟踪器和3D几何模型生成含遮挡插值的轨迹，再训练一个前馈轨迹修正器，沿轨迹与跨轨迹交替注意力以保留可靠观测、修复错误位置并补全缺失运动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「筛除受污染观测、修复并补全状态」的修正机制与训练时注入模拟误差的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的证据筛选与迭代更新提供借鉴线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或语言模型。
